$comment: Stratum-B G4 projection config (template spec §2). GAP register row under a DEPTH RULING: SC #21 classes NAICS 22 Axis-2 only, avoid-class 5 — 'the depth ruling, not the name shortage, is the binding constraint' (register note, carried verbatim). This projection therefore runs under a placeholder org.ai address per spec §0 (energy.org.ai is a held G2 namespace, not a market face) at the ruled noun-grain: the metering.click + interconnection.click entry-artifact grain, no apex face, no data-thesis face. Nothing here implies acquisition of any name — the register itself notes the depth ruling weakens the case for buying an apex name in this cell. Repo config, not a served surface.

The ruled posture: metering.click + interconnection.click are the compatible held entry artifacts; energy.org.ai (held G2 namespace) is the placeholder address until/unless a name is ruled via #16 — and the SC #21 depth ruling weakens the acquisition case relative to other GAP rows (register note). Naming is #3/#16's job, never this build's.
